append.detail: 2026-10-06: the four post-sign-in claims live in lib/auth/post-sign-in.ts (runGuestClaims for seats, leads and tickets; runPostSignInClaims adds the order leg); app/auth/callback calls the shared legs and keeps the order leg in place (PROG-GD5 pins it), same order and session client. POST /api/v1/session/bootstrap runs all four as the bearer caller, idempotent, and emits account.created on the callback's key. /auth/native is the universal-link return (claimed in the association file; forwards to /auth/callback on the web). docs/APP-CONTRACT.md §11 states the redirect URLs and the refresh story. Tested in app/api/v1/session/bootstrap/route.test.ts.
